records.title: NDTV: warrants → founder share purchase → new issuer capital
records.summary: A 2022 warrant conversion and shareholder purchases transferred control; the later 2025 rights issue raised new capital for NDTV. INR 1.99 crore exercise deposit, INR 294/share open offer, INR 342.65/share founder block and INR 3,964.98 million issuer proceeds are separate stages. March 2026 standalone holdings are RRPR 59.80% and VCPL 9.22%, not the 2022 group 64.71% snapshot. A January 2023 notice promises INR 48.65/share extra to accepted open-offer sellers to equalise their initial price with the founder price; this is a commitment, not independently verified final settlement.

geography.note: India public-interest context; no project-level delivery, payment destination or residence is established.
